label: Wudang Swordswoman
description: a graceful young Wudang swordswoman: long black hair in a high bun held by a jade hairpin with a few loose strands, a calm determined face, a white and pale-blue Taoist robe with wide flowing sleeves and a blue sash belt, white trousers, black cloth shoes, holding a straight double-edged jian sword with a silver blade and a long blue tassel on the hilt
overflow: the sword blade, the sword tassel or the wide sleeves
portrait: a calm, piercing gaze, the jian sword held upright beside the face with its blade catching the light and the blue tassel flowing
portrait_bg: misty pale blue mountains at dawn

moves.block: the sword held flat and horizontal
moves.light: A fast straight sword thrust toward the LEFT at chest height, the arm and blade fully extended.
moves.light_hit: the sword thrust straight forward to the LEFT at chest height
moves.heavy: A wide low sword slash along the ground toward the LEFT, aimed at the shins, the body crouched low.
moves.heavy_hit: the sword slashing low to the LEFT just above the ground
moves.charge: White wind ribbons and a pale blue glow swirl around her and along the blade (white and pale blue only).
moves.special_fx: White wind ribbons and pale blue light trail the sword (white and pale blue only).
hits: a rising diagonal sword slash with a white wind trail
a spinning horizontal sword slash with a pale blue arc
a lunging sword thrust releasing a large spiral of white wind
